scope: All 112 consolidated inventory records concern finite discrete inputs/outputs or finite-description complexity problems. Continuous optimization, numerical linear algebra, differential equations and Hamiltonian simulation are outside these additions.
research_notes: Complexities retain oracle, coherent sample, time, communication-round, exact-versus-bounded-error, and width/precision parameters explicitly.
New preprint claims are attributed to their primary source; publication maturity differs from the mathematical evidence category.
The quantum-double fluxon subfamily has a polynomial classical algorithm in the same primary paper.
Topological approximation comparisons include the size-qualified sparse Boolean path-counting upper bound, with encoding size kept separate from input width.
